literal:正在接收 Live UDP。菜单、暂停或数据中断时，HUD 会自: Receiving Live UDP. The HUD hides automatically in menus, while paused, or when data stops.
literal:正在使用模拟数据，不会写入 Live 记录。: Using simulated data. Live records will not be changed.
literal:管理需要手动开关的功能。: Manage features that can be turned on or off manually.
literal:显示车辆状态，并学习当前车辆的换挡区间。: Shows vehicle status and learns shift ranges for the current car.
literal:显示方向与换挡建议、侧滑角和积分速度趋势，优先提示失控风险。: Shows steering and shift guidance, slip angle and score-rate trends, with loss-of-control warnings first.
literal:识别赛道、记录圈速，并对比分段与走线。: Identifies tracks, records lap times, and compares sectors and racing lines.
literal:开启后暂停圈速分析和圈速写入；关闭后恢复原设置。: Pauses lap analysis and lap storage while enabled, then restores the previous settings.
literal:关闭此选项后，漂移仪表盘可以和主仪表盘同时显示。: Turn this off to show the drift and main dashboards together.
literal:请先关闭漂移仪表盘，再启用圈速分析。: Close the drift dashboard before enabling lap analysis.
literal:查看本场分段与已完成圈；暂停、菜单或倒转不会结束比赛。: View sectors and completed laps. Pausing, opening a menu, or reversing does not end the session.
literal:上一场比赛结果将在结束后保留 5 分钟。: Results from the previous session remain available for five minutes.
literal:进入赛事后自动显示；上一场结果保留 5 分钟。: Appears automatically when a session starts. Previous results remain for five minutes.
literal:返回驾驶后继续记录当前比赛。: Recording resumes when you return to driving.
literal:完成一圈后显示圈速与分段。: Lap and sector times appear after a completed lap.
literal:选择赛道，对比已保存的圈速、分段和走线。: Select a track to compare saved laps, sectors and racing lines.
literal:从上方选择赛道，或进入比赛后自动识别。: Select a track above, or let LazyForza identify it when a session starts.
literal:选择至少一个性能等级。: Select at least one performance class.
literal:勾选最多 4 圈，再点击“显示勾选圈数据”。: Select up to four laps, then choose Show selected laps.
literal:点击“显示勾选圈数据”加载速度曲线与走线。: Choose Show selected laps to load speed traces and racing lines.
literal:完成对应等级的比赛后显示。: Results appear after completing a session in that class.
literal:一次性加载当前勾选圈的速度与走线数据: Load speed traces and racing lines for the selected laps
literal:可按筛选等级删除，并选择是否保留历史最快圈: Delete by filtered class and choose whether to keep historical bests
literal:导出固定尺寸的圈速分析图片: Export a fixed-size lap analysis image
literal:管理自定义赛道，浏览内置官方赛事。: Manage custom tracks and browse built-in official events.
literal:管理车辆配置，并根据有效加速数据学习升降挡提示。: Manage car profiles and learn shift guidance from valid acceleration data.
literal:管理 Live UDP、HUD、界面、录制、更新与本地数据。监听: Manage Live UDP, HUDs, appearance, recordings, updates and local data. Listener changes apply after restart.
literal:用于新录制和圈速分享；首次加入地产赛事时作为代表名默认值。可留空: Used for new recordings and shared laps, and as the default name when first joining an estate race. Optional; does not overwrite your last race name.
literal:最多 20 个字符；留空表示不标注: Up to 20 characters; leave blank to omit
literal:以 Forza Horizon 6 当前窗口为背景，拖动并缩放: Move and resize HUDs over the current Forza Horizon 6 window
literal:恢复 Overlay、仪表盘部件与地产赛事部件的默认布局；不修改: Restore default Overlay, dashboard and estate-race layouts without changing the listener
literal:备份、迁移并恢复 LazyForza 的个人数据。: Back up, move and restore your LazyForza data.
literal:达到上限后轮换最旧的普通自动录制: Remove the oldest unprotected automatic recording at the limit
literal:查看 UDP、原始帧、模块状态和本地文件。: Inspect UDP, raw frames, module state and local files.
literal:打开 .lfztelemetry 录制文件或回看已保存单圈；工作: Open an .lfztelemetry recording or review saved laps. Replay reads local data only and does not affect live telemetry or HUDs.
literal:支持自动/手动原始录制，以及由工作台导出的单圈 .lfztele: Supports automatic and manual raw recordings, plus single-lap .lfztelemetry files exported here.
literal:导出当前工作台单圈；不会伪造缺失的原始 FH6 UDP 字段: Export the current lap without inventing missing FH6 UDP fields
literal:仍可从上方打开 .lfztelemetry 录制文件。: You can still open an .lfztelemetry recording above.
literal:连接地产赛事房间，以参赛车手或 OB 身份加入。: Join an estate-race room as a driver or observer.
literal:导出固定尺寸的赛后复盘图片: Export a fixed-size race review image
literal:选择 HUD 后拖动或中心缩放；地产赛事部件使用独立全屏画布。编: Select a HUD, then drag or scale from its center. Estate-race widgets use a full-screen canvas. Press F2 to hide this panel, Esc to cancel, or Ctrl+S to save.
literal:将圈速 HUD 的中心、位置和缩放精确同步到仪表盘: Match the lap HUD center, position and scale to the dashboard
literal:手动选择地图后启用，按已录入的起终点线记录圈速。: Select a map manually, then time laps from its recorded start/finish gate.
literal:新赛道：沿起终点横线往返描摹 → 直穿终点线确认方向 → 参考圈: New track: trace the start/finish line in both directions, cross it to confirm race direction, then complete a reference and validation lap. Recordings can be saved as drafts; saved tracks can update each pit component separately.
literal:你学习的赛道，可重命名或删除。: Tracks learned by LazyForza. Rename or delete them here.
literal:进入比赛并完整跑完路线。环道再次过线后保存，定点赛道在完赛后保存: Enter an event and complete the route. Circuits are saved after crossing the line again; point-to-point tracks are saved at the finish.
literal:还没有自定义赛道。点击“添加赛道”开始学习。: No custom tracks yet. Choose Add track to begin learning.
literal:内置官方赛事模板，只读。缩略图来自实际行驶轨迹。: Built-in read-only event templates. Thumbnails are based on recorded driving lines.
literal:先沿起终点横线低速往返描摹，再直穿终点线确认比赛方向；随后连续完: Trace the start/finish line slowly in both directions, then cross it to confirm race direction. Complete a reference lap followed by a validation lap. Live traces appear on the right.
literal:车头沿横线摆正，以 2–12 km/h 从一侧驶到另一侧；掉头后: Align the car with the line and drive across it at 2–12 km/h. Turn around and trace the same line in the opposite direction. Do not cross it in race direction yet.
literal:停止终点线前约 10 米，开始采样后按正常比赛方向直穿终点线并继: Stop about 10 metres before the line. Start sampling, cross in race direction, and continue beyond it.
literal:完整跑完一圈，不要倒带、传送、暂停或进站。: Complete one full lap without rewinding, fast travelling, pausing or entering the pits.
literal:保持相同比赛方向再跑一圈，用来核对路线一致性。: Complete another lap in the same direction to verify the route.
literal:黄/紫 描摹 · 绿 方向 · 黄 起终点 · 白 车辆: Yellow/purple trace · Green direction · Yellow start/finish · White car
literal:开始录入后，这里会实时显示采样轨迹: Live samples will appear here after recording starts
literal:在赛道页手动添加或选择地产环道。: Add or select an estate circuit from Tracks.
literal:每次只修改选中的组件，其他赛道数据保持不变。: Edit one component at a time. All other track data remains unchanged.
literal:黄 起终点 · 紫 通道 · 绿/橙 出入口 · 绿色区域 换胎: Yellow start/finish · Purple lane · Green/orange entry and exit · Green service zone
literal:1. 沿起终点横线低速走一次，停止采集。\n2. 掉头沿同一横线:
1. Trace the start/finish line slowly once and stop sampling.
2. Turn around and trace the same line in reverse.
3. Cross in race direction and continue for about 10 metres.
4. Review the preview and save.
literal:停止第二次描摹并拟合: Stop reverse trace and fit gate
literal:先完成两次横向描摹，再采集正常比赛方向。原定义会在确认保存前保持: Complete both line traces, then capture the normal race direction. The current definition remains unchanged until you save.
literal:只重新采集维修区中心通道。原入口线、出口线、换胎区和规则参数会保: Re-record only the pit-lane centreline. Entry, exit, service zone and rule settings are retained and revalidated when saved.
literal:只重设入口线。把车停在新入口线中心约 1 秒后确认；其他维修区数: Reset only the entry gate. Stop at its centre for about one second, then confirm. All other pit data remains unchanged.
literal:只重设出口线。把车停在新出口线中心约 1 秒后确认；其他维修区数: Reset only the exit gate. Stop at its centre for about one second, then confirm. All other pit data remains unchanged.
literal:只重录换胎区边界。依次在边界角点停车确认；通道、出入口和规则参数: Re-record only the service-zone boundary. Stop at each corner in order. The lane, gates and rule settings remain unchanged.
literal:只修改限速、通道宽度和最短服务时间，不需要重新驾驶录入。几何数据: Change only the speed limit, lane width and minimum service time. No driving is required and geometry remains unchanged.
literal:按比赛方向录入维修区通道，再分别确认入口线、出口线和换胎区边界。: Record the pit lane in race direction, then confirm its entry gate, exit gate and service-zone boundary.
literal:从中心线向左右各扩出的范围，通常 3–5 米。: Distance from the centreline to either edge, usually 3–5 metres.
literal:用于赛事规则与超速提示，不是游戏内强制限速。: Used for race rules and speeding alerts; it does not limit the car in-game.
literal:车辆在换胎区以不高于 5 km/h 连续停留达到此时间，软件才记: A service is counted after the car remains in the service zone at no more than 5 km/h for this duration.
literal:点击“准备录入”后开始本次修改。: Choose Prepare to begin this edit.
literal:确认参数后准备保存。: Review the values, then prepare to save.
literal:修改参数后点击准备，再直接保存。限速是 LazyForza 赛事: Change the values, choose Prepare, then save. The limit is a LazyForza race rule and does not change the in-game car limit.
literal:LazyForza 记录车辆进入换胎区并完成设定停留；具体维修操: LazyForza records entry into the service zone and the configured stop duration. Perform the actual service in-game.
literal:连接赛事房间，以参赛车手或 OB 身份加入。: Join a race room as a driver or observer.
literal:进入房间时会读取服务端指定的赛道，并自动启用本机相同的地产环道。: Joining loads the server-selected track and starts the matching local estate circuit automatically.
literal:选择 Cloudflare 一键部署或自行部署。: Deploy with Cloudflare or run the server yourself.
literal:登录 Cloudflare 账号并确认创建 Worker 与 D: Sign in to Cloudflare and approve the Worker and Durable Object. Open the assigned domain after deployment to set room and control passwords.
literal:下载对应系统的服务端包并运行，浏览器访问 http://服务器地: Download and run the server package for your OS, then open http://server-address:24876 to configure it. Public deployments require HTTPS and an open or reverse-proxied server port.
literal:默认仅监听本机；端口范围 1–65535，请避开 5200–53: Listens on this PC by default. Use UDP port 1–65535 and avoid 5200–5300. Tire temperatures are shown in °C.
literal:运行时始终点击穿透且不可移动；位置与大小只在布局编辑器中调整。: HUDs are click-through and fixed while running. Change position and size in the layout editor.
literal:分别调整三个主 HUD；地产赛事部件在可视化布局编辑器中独立缩放: Adjust the three main HUDs here. Estate-race widgets scale independently in the visual layout editor.
literal:按 1% 调整，并保持仪表盘中心点不变: Adjust in 1% steps while keeping the dashboard center fixed
literal:按 1% 调整，并保持圈速 HUD 中心点不变: Adjust in 1% steps while keeping the lap HUD center fixed
literal:按 1% 调整，并保持漂移 HUD 中心点不变: Adjust in 1% steps while keeping the drift HUD center fixed
literal:控制动画和仪表盘加速度跟随。: Control animations and dashboard acceleration response.
literal:各部件可独立开关；位置请在 Overlay 布局编辑器中拖动，并: Toggle widgets independently. Move them in the Overlay layout editor or restore the default layout in one step.
literal:十一个部件可独立开关；进入 Overlay 布局编辑器后可直接选: Toggle all eleven widgets independently. Select, move, scale or restore them in the Overlay layout editor.
literal:十一个赛事部件分别保存透明度，互不影响。: Opacity is stored separately for each of the eleven race widgets.
literal:只调整这个部件，不影响其他 HUD。: Adjusts this widget only. Other HUDs are unaffected.
literal:数据库升级和自动更新前会先创建可恢复副本。: Creates a recoverable copy before database upgrades and automatic updates.
literal:选择要迁移的数据。导出完成前会校验备份内容。: Select the data to move. The backup is verified before export completes.
literal:圈速、分段和遥测样本: Lap times, sectors and telemetry samples
literal:圈速会自动包含所需的赛道定义。: Required track definitions are included with lap data automatically.
literal:先校验文件并预览冲突，再决定是否导入。: Validate the file and preview conflicts before importing.
literal:保留本机同名记录: Keep local records with the same name
literal:尚未选择备份文件。选择文件后会显示版本、内容数量和冲突。: No backup selected. Choose a file to view its version, contents and conflicts.
literal:连续完成系统指定的干净圈。: Complete the required consecutive clean laps.
literal:长距离进行中：保持正常比赛节奏，不要进站、暂停、回转或越过赛道边: Long run in progress: keep a normal race pace and do not pit, pause, turn around or leave the course.
literal:保持行驶 · 不得停车或暂停: Keep moving · Do not stop or pause
literal:未按期执行 · 已替换为完赛加时: Missed deadline · Converted to post-race time
literal:本圈必须进入维修区执行: Serve in the pit lane this lap
literal:驶过维修区且不得停车: Drive through the pit lane without stopping
literal:保持静止 · 不要打开暂停菜单: Remain stationary · Do not open the pause menu
literal:先执行罚时，完成后才能开始换胎: Serve the time penalty before starting service
literal:前三个有效完整圈用于建立基准: The first three valid full laps establish the baseline
literal:蓝旗 · 后方快车正在套圈: Blue flag · Faster car approaching to lap
literal:请保持可预判路线，并在安全位置让行: Hold a predictable line and yield safely
literal:.lfzlap 保留圈速、走线、动态遥测和玩家代号；导入后可直接: .lfzlap stores lap times, racing lines, dynamic telemetry and player code. Imported laps can be compared immediately.
literal:比赛中会自动识别赛道；手动切换将结束当前分析。: Tracks are identified automatically during a session. Manual switching ends the current analysis.
literal:普通赛事会自动识别；地产环道需要在这里手动选择后查看圈速。: Official events are identified automatically. Select an estate circuit here to view its laps.
literal:保持空选；进入比赛后自动识别: Leave empty to identify the track automatically when a session starts
literal:颜色：灰 未跑；黄 较慢；绿 本场最快；紫 本机历史最快（不是在: Colors: gray not run; yellow slower; green session best; purple local historical best (not an online world record).
literal:点击准备后，从赛道分流点前开始，以 2–25 km/h 沿通道中: Choose Prepare, then drive from before pit entry to beyond pit exit at 2–25 km/h along the lane centre. Stop recording, review the preview, and save.
literal:点击准备，把车停在新入口线的通道中心约 1 秒，确认入口线。软件: Choose Prepare, stop at the centre of the new entry gate for about one second, and confirm. LazyForza creates the gate from the local lane direction; review and save.
literal:点击准备，把车停在新出口线的通道中心约 1 秒，确认出口线。出口: Choose Prepare, stop at the centre of the new exit gate for about one second, and confirm. The exit must follow the entry; review and save.
literal:点击准备，按顺时针或逆时针依次停在换胎区边界角点。每点停稳约 1: Choose Prepare, then stop at service-zone boundary corners in clockwise or counter-clockwise order. Record 4–8 points after holding each for about one second; review and save.
literal:1. 从分流点前开始，沿通道中心完整驶到并道点后。\n2. 在入:
1. Drive from before pit entry to beyond pit exit along the lane centre.
2. Stop at the entry and exit gate centres to confirm them.
3. Record the service-zone boundary in one direction.
4. Review the preview and save.

literal:每次只进行一个项目。检测到回转、赛道边界、旗语、超速等异常后会自: Run one test at a time. U-turns, boundary events, flags or speeding end the test automatically. Valid completed stages are kept; invalid laps and unfinished stages are discarded. Pause is available only in the service zone during a pit simulation.

literal:只比较继续跑与一次虚拟换胎的预计用时，不代表 FH6 真实胎况，: Compares staying out with one simulated tire change. It does not represent actual FH6 tire condition and excludes weather, traffic, opponent strategy and unserved penalties. Abnormal time loss from boundary incidents is excluded from the pace trend.
literal:抓地提示不是轮胎磨损值。FH6 UDP 不提供轮胎磨损、车损或换: Grip guidance is not tire wear. FH6 UDP provides no tire-wear, damage or tire-change completion fields. The HUD classifies this lap's tire-slip samples into four levels. Pit service means only that the car entered the recorded service zone; service complete means only that the configured low-speed stop time was reached.

literal:车辆按车型折叠整理；展开后可管理各调校。不同 PI 必定分开，同: Profiles are grouped by car. Expand a car to manage its tunes. Different PI values are always separate; the same PI creates a new tune only when several stable characteristics remain different.
literal:还没有已保存配置。完成有效加速学习后会自动出现在这里。: No saved profiles yet. Complete valid acceleration learning to create one.
literal:换挡目标已就绪。继续驾驶可提高稳定性。: Shift targets are ready. Keep driving to improve stability.
literal:样本不足，继续完成有效加速。: Not enough samples. Continue with valid acceleration runs.
literal:继续正常驾驶即可。更换车辆、发动机或传动配置后需要重新学习。: Continue driving normally. Changing the car, engine or drivetrain requires new learning.
literal:在平直道路上以 90% 以上油门，从中低转速连续加速并跨过至少两: On a straight road, use over 90% throttle and accelerate continuously from low-to-mid RPM through at least two gears. Two or three runs are usually enough; wheelspin, collisions, clutch use and low throttle are excluded.

literal:调整 HUD 的等待、保留和淡入淡出时间。: Adjust HUD wait, hold and fade timing.
literal:诊断页用于排查 UDP、赛道识别、模块与本地文件问题；日常使用可: Diagnostics helps investigate UDP, track recognition, modules and local files. It can stay hidden for daily use.
literal:默认隐藏诊断入口。开启后，侧边栏会增加“诊断”；关闭不会删除诊断: Diagnostics is hidden by default. Enabling it adds Diagnostics to the sidebar; disabling it does not delete records or affect diagnostic packages.
literal:仅在 Live 模式生效；自动保留赛前 15 秒和赛后 10 秒: Live mode only. Keeps 15 seconds before and 10 seconds after each race for complete replay and session-boundary coverage.
literal:默认关闭。开启后仍会保留最近 5 场，并跳过手动固定、个人最佳圈: Off by default. When enabled, the latest five sessions, pinned recordings, personal bests and track-recognition anomalies are still protected.

literal:Spin 风险、方向修正和换挡建议仍需结合更多真实 FH6 漂移: Spin risk, steering corrections and shift cues still require calibration with more real FH6 drift data. Shift arrows are intended to reduce loss-of-control risk, not mark the vehicle's optimal shift point. Treat the display as practice assistance only.

literal:进入正赛并完成至少三个干净圈后开始计算。: Calculation starts after at least three clean race laps.
literal:磁盘剩余空间低于录制保留值。: Free disk space is below the recording reserve.

literal:已轮换最旧的未保护自动录制。: The oldest unprotected automatic recording was rotated out.
literal:受保护录制已占满容量，无法开始新的自动录制。: Protected recordings occupy the available capacity, so a new automatic recording cannot start.
literal:当前运行的是开发构建，已阻止发行包覆盖开发目录。请在完整发行版中: This is a development build. Installing a release over the development directory is blocked; use a complete release build instead.

literal:漂移仪表盘开启时，圈速分析会保持关闭且不会记录新的圈速。请先关闭: Lap analysis remains disabled while the drift dashboard is active, so new laps are not recorded. Close the drift dashboard first.

literal:录制文件中没有可供工作台回放的驾驶帧。: The recording contains no driving frames that can be replayed in the workbench.

literal:恢复全部仪表盘部件的默认显示状态和当前位置: Restore default visibility and position for all dashboard widgets
literal:接近仪表盘，可继续微调间隔: Close to the dashboard; fine-tune the spacing if needed

literal:暂时隐藏提示和按钮，避免遮挡 HUD；按 F2 可再次显示: Hide editor hints and controls temporarily; press F2 to show them again
literal:HUD 可临时隐藏后重叠摆放；地产赛事各部件可在整个游戏窗口内独: HUDs can be hidden temporarily for overlapping layouts; estate-race widgets can be adjusted independently across the game window
literal:双击恢复默认位置: Double-click to restore the default position
literal:双击恢复默认位置与大小: Double-click to restore the default position and size

literal:比赛会话结束时仍有一圈未能结算。: One lap could not be finalized when the race session ended.

literal:地产计时请在“赛道”页手动启动；这里用于筛选、比较和导出已保存的: Start estate timing manually on the Tracks page. This page filters, compares and exports saved laps.
literal:等待起点，随后自动识别赛道。: Waiting for the start, then track identification begins automatically.
literal:等待首次通过起终点线。: Waiting for the first start/finish crossing.
literal:方向/曲率/起点距离排名未进入精匹配集合（当前最多 12 条）: Direction, curvature and start-distance ranking did not enter the detailed match set (up to 12).
literal:观测到闭环返回起点，路线类型与定点赛不符: A closed loop returned to the start; the route does not match a point-to-point event.
literal:轨迹不足，已从本次起点重新开始。: Not enough trace data; capture restarted from this start.
literal:检测到倒转，已取消本次学习。: Rewind detected; this learning run was cancelled.
literal:检测到过线或完赛信号，但当前圈未能结算。: A crossing or finish signal was detected, but the current lap could not be finalized.
literal:进入赛事后自动识别赛道。: Identifies the track automatically after entering the event.
literal:没有找到匹配赛道，本场不会记录圈速。: No matching track was found; lap times will not be recorded for this session.
literal:起点区域空间索引无相邻路线: No nearby route was found in the start-area index
literal:起点确认后开始学习。: Learning starts after the start is confirmed.
literal:起点确认后重新采集。: Capture restarts after the start is confirmed.
literal:圈速 HUD 即将隐藏。可在赛道页添加自定义赛道。: The lap HUD will hide shortly. Add a custom track on the Tracks page.
literal:赛道识别纠错只能应用于当前正在进行的比赛。: Track correction can only be applied to the current active race.
literal:所选赛道与当前遥测来源或分段算法版本不兼容。: The selected track is incompatible with the current telemetry source or sector algorithm version.
literal:完成本圈即可保存。: Complete this lap to save it.
literal:完整跑完路线，期间不要倒带、传送或退出。: Complete the route without rewinding, fast travel or leaving the event.
literal:完整跑完路线即可保存。: Complete the route to save it.
literal:为保证圈速完整，将从下次经过起点后开始记录。: Recording starts at the next start crossing to preserve a complete lap.
literal:已进入比赛，等待起点。: Race detected; waiting for the start.
literal:重新通过起点，再完整跑完一条环道或定点赛道。: Cross the start again, then complete the circuit or point-to-point route.
literal:按比赛方向，从分流点前开始完整录入通道，到并道点后再结束。: Follow race direction and record the full lane from before the split to beyond the merge.
literal:按同一绕行方向记录换胎区边界，至少 4 个点。: Record at least four service-zone boundary points in one consistent direction.
literal:把车停在出口线中心约 1 秒，然后确认出口线。: Stop at the center of the exit line for about one second, then confirm it.
literal:把车停在入口线中心约 1 秒，然后确认入口线。: Stop at the center of the entry line for about one second, then confirm it.
literal:本圈不会保存；恢复正常行驶后，下一次正向通过终点线会重新开始计时: This lap will not be saved. Timing restarts at the next forward finish-line crossing after normal driving resumes.
literal:比赛方向样本不足，请直穿终点线后再停止采样。: Not enough race-direction samples. Drive straight through the finish line before stopping capture.
literal:必须依次通过全部检查点并保持在路线范围内。: Pass every checkpoint in order and remain within the recorded route.
literal:边界已闭合，可以保存；如换胎区不是四边形，可继续记录到最多 8: The boundary is closed and can be saved. If the service zone is not rectangular, record up to eight points.
literal:参考路线已保留；重新开始完整验证圈。: The reference route is preserved; restart the full validation lap.
literal:参考圈不会保存；恢复正常行驶后，下一次正向通过终点线会重新开始录: The reference lap will not be saved. Recording restarts at the next forward finish-line crossing after normal driving resumes.
literal:车辆不在已录入的维修区通道附近，请停到通道中心线后重试。: The vehicle is not near the recorded pit lane. Stop on its centerline and try again.
literal:车辆沿赛道明显回退或使用回转: Vehicle moved backward along the route or rewind was used
literal:出口线必须位于入口线之后，且两条线至少间隔 2 米。: The exit line must follow the entry line with at least two meters between them.
literal:从终点线前方驶向后方，直穿终点线至少 10 米。: Drive straight from before the finish line to at least 10 meters beyond it.
literal:当前步骤不能开始参考圈录入。: Reference-lap recording cannot start at this step.
literal:当前步骤不能开始维修区通道录入。: Pit-lane recording cannot start at this step.
literal:当前步骤不能开始终点线描摹。: Finish-line tracing cannot start at this step.
literal:当前没有可重试的验证圈。: There is no validation lap to retry.

literal:地产赛道定义已不存在。: The estate-track definition no longer exists.
literal:地图修订号不能超过 32 个字符。: The map revision cannot exceed 32 characters.
literal:等待首次正向通过终点线。: Waiting for the first forward finish-line crossing.
literal:第一次描摹已保存，等待第二次描摹。: First trace saved; waiting for the second trace.
literal:第一次描摹有效样本不足，请重新采集。: The first trace has too few valid samples. Record it again.
literal:掉头后开始第二次反向描摹。: Turn around, then start the second trace in the opposite direction.
literal:分享代码或地图标识不能超过 80 个字符。: The share code or map identifier cannot exceed 80 characters.
literal:服务端开始排位赛或正赛后，LazyForza 会自动启用圈速计时: Lap timing starts automatically when the server begins qualifying or the race.
literal:过线后完整行驶一圈；不要倒带、传送或离开地产。: After crossing the line, complete one full lap without rewinding, fast travel or leaving the estate.
literal:换胎区最多记录 8 个边界点。需要重录时请先清空角点。: The service zone supports up to eight boundary points. Clear them before recording again.
literal:继续按同一绕行方向记录角点，至少需要 4 个且围成面积大于 4: Continue recording points in one direction. At least four points enclosing more than 4 m² are required.
literal:继续终点线描摹。正在采集但未完成的单次描摹已丢弃。: Continue finish-line tracing. The incomplete active trace was discarded.
literal:检测到车辆沿赛道明显回退或使用回转: Vehicle moved backward along the route or rewind was detected
literal:检测到跨越赛道大段路线的切弯: A large route section was skipped
literal:检测到位置跳变或使用回转: A position jump or rewind was detected
literal:检查预览后保存；保存前原赛道不会改变。: Review the preview before saving. The original track remains unchanged until then.
literal:开始比赛方向采样，然后按正常比赛方向直穿终点线。: Start race-direction capture, then drive straight through the finish line in normal race direction.
literal:开始参考圈录入；首次正向过线开始，下一次正向过线结束。: Start reference-lap recording. It begins at the first forward crossing and ends at the next.
literal:可关闭向导，在赛道页手动启用地产计时。: You may close the guide and enable estate timing manually on the Tracks page.
literal:录入的维修区通道没有沿比赛方向穿过起终点所在平面。请从入口前开始: The recorded pit lane does not cross the start/finish plane in race direction. Record again from before entry through beyond exit.
literal:录入已经完成，不需要暂存。: Recording is complete; no draft is needed.
literal:没有找到所选地产环道。: The selected estate circuit was not found.
literal:没有找到所选赛道。: The selected track was not found.
literal:没有找到要修改的地产环道。: The estate circuit to edit was not found.
literal:请把车停稳约 1 秒后再记录角点。: Stop the vehicle for about one second before recording the point.
literal:请把车停在需要设置的门线中心约 1 秒后再确认。: Stop at the center of the gate for about one second before confirming it.
literal:请保持 2–30 km/h，从分流点前连续驶到并道点后重新录入。: Maintain 2–30 km/h and record continuously from before the split to beyond the merge.
literal:请先结束当前地产流程，再恢复暂存。: Finish the current estate workflow before restoring a draft.
literal:请先结束当前地产流程，再重设起终点线。: Finish the current estate workflow before resetting the start/finish line.
literal:请先填写地图信息并开始录入。: Enter the map information and start recording first.
literal:请先停止地产计时或赛道录入，再配置维修区。: Stop estate timing or track recording before configuring the pit area.
literal:请先完成或取消维修区录入。: Finish or cancel pit-area recording first.
literal:请先完成两次合格的终点线描摹。: Complete two valid finish-line traces first.
literal:请先完成两次终点线描摹和比赛方向采样。: Complete both finish-line traces and race-direction capture first.
literal:请先选择地产环道并开始维修区录入。: Select an estate circuit and start pit-area recording first.
literal:入口、通道、维修停留区、维修区起终点门和出口会随 .lfzest: The .lfzestate file includes the entry, lane, service zone, pit gates and exit.

literal:首次正向过线开始计时；暂停、回转、传送或偏离赛道会使当前圈无效，: Timing starts at the first forward crossing. Pausing, rewinding, fast travel or leaving the route invalidates the lap while timing remains active.
literal:首次正向过线开始计时；正赛中的暂停、回转和偏离赛道不会取消计圈，: Timing starts at the first forward crossing. During a race, pauses, rewinds and route deviations do not cancel lap counting; the server continues race time.
literal:所选赛道缺少地产环道定义。: The selected track has no estate-circuit definition.
literal:所选赛道缺少地产计时定义。: The selected track has no estate-timing definition.
literal:所选项目已完成，可以保存。未选择的维修区数据会原样保留。: The selected edit is complete and can be saved. Unselected pit data remains unchanged.
literal:停车后按顺时针或逆时针重新记录至少 4 个角点。: Stop, then record at least four boundary points clockwise or counterclockwise.
literal:停止当前流程后重新开始。: Stop the current workflow and start again.
literal:完整行驶一圈并再次正向通过终点线。: Complete one lap and cross the finish line forward again.
literal:维修区入口或出口方向样本不足。: Not enough direction samples for the pit entry or exit.
literal:维修区入口线必须位于出口线之前，且两条线至少间隔 2 米。: The pit entry line must precede the exit line with at least two meters between them.
literal:维修区通道、入口线、出口线或换胎区边界尚未完成，不能保存。: The pit lane, entry line, exit line or service-zone boundary is incomplete.
literal:维修区通道样本或长度不足。请从入口前重新开始，完整驶到出口后再停: The pit-lane trace is too short or has too few samples. Record again from before entry to beyond exit.
literal:新起终点线必须位于原起终点位置 10 米范围内。若地图起点已明显: The new start/finish line must remain within 10 meters of the original. If the map start moved farther, record the full track again.
literal:新起终点线和比赛方向已确认。: New start/finish line and race direction confirmed.
literal:新起终点线与现有维修区通道不再相交。请先重设维修区通道，或重新录: The new start/finish line no longer intersects the pit lane. Reset the pit lane or record the full track again.
literal:修正行驶路线后重试验证圈；必要时重新录入参考圈。: Correct the driving route and retry the validation lap; record the reference lap again if needed.
literal:沿通道中心继续驶到出口后，停车并结束录入。: Continue along the lane center beyond the exit, then stop and end recording.
literal:验证圈不会保存；恢复正常行驶后，下一次正向通过终点线会重新开始验: The validation lap will not be saved. Validation restarts at the next forward finish-line crossing after normal driving resumes.
literal:依次通过检查点后返回终点线。: Pass the checkpoints in order, then return to the finish line.
literal:已从本次过线开始下一圈。: The next lap started at this crossing.
literal:以 2–30 km/h 从赛道分流点前开始，沿通道中心驶过维修区: At 2–30 km/h, record from before the split along the pit-lane center to beyond the merge, then stop and end recording.
literal:以约 2–12 km/h 沿棋盘格横线行驶，覆盖完整赛道宽度。: Drive along the chequered line at about 2–12 km/h and cover the full track width.
literal:在地产赛道列表中选择“配置维修区”。: Choose Configure pit area from the estate-track list.

literal:正向过线后完成一圈，必须依次通过所有检查点。: Complete one lap after a forward crossing and pass every checkpoint in order.

literal:只能为地产环道配置维修区。: A pit area can only be configured for an estate circuit.
literal:终点门和比赛方向已确认。: Finish gate and race direction confirmed.
literal:终点线和比赛方向已保留；重新开始完整参考圈。: Finish line and race direction preserved; restart the full reference lap.
literal:终点线已保留；继续采集正常比赛方向。: Finish line preserved; continue capturing normal race direction.
literal:作者名称不能超过 80 个字符。: The creator name cannot exceed 80 characters.
literal:当前还有待执行处罚；预测没有把处罚时间当作正常进站损失。: A penalty is still pending; its service time is excluded from normal pit-loss estimates.
literal:本场不再计算新的进站窗口。: No new pit window will be calculated for this race.
literal:本次进站已经开始，窗口预测将在出站并取得新的代表圈后重新评估。: This stop has started. The pit window will be recalculated after exit and a new representative lap.
literal:不再计算新的进站窗口。: No new pit window will be calculated.
literal:当前地产环道没有完整的维修区定义，无法估算进站损失。: This estate circuit has no complete pit definition, so pit loss cannot be estimated.
literal:等待同赛道策略样本: Waiting for strategy samples from this track
literal:继续完成当前圈，不再安排额外进站。: Complete the current lap; no additional stop will be scheduled.
literal:历史飞驰圈可用于核对基础速度，但不能代替长距离轮胎衰退数据；建议: Historical flying laps can verify baseline pace but cannot replace long-run tire-degradation data. Complete a long run in practice.
literal:练习赛测试获得的新样本会立即保存并刷新预测基线。: New practice-test samples are saved immediately and refresh the prediction baseline.
literal:没有找到本机参赛车手，暂时无法预测。: The local racing driver was not found, so no prediction is available yet.
literal:排位赛期间继续保留已载入基线，正赛开始后自动计算进站窗口。: The loaded baseline remains available in qualifying; pit-window calculation starts with the race.
literal:剩余赛程不足以回收一次额外进站的损失。: Too few laps remain to recover the loss of an additional stop.
literal:维修区几何或完整进站时间不足，暂时不输出容易误导的窗口。: Pit geometry or complete stop-time data is insufficient, so no unreliable window is shown.
literal:已进入房间；正在识别本机车辆，随后会载入同赛道策略样本。: Room joined. Identifying the local vehicle, then loading strategy samples for this track.
literal:已没有可安排的完整比赛圈。: No complete race lap remains for a scheduled stop.
literal:已有飞驰圈基线，等待长距离样本: Flying-lap baseline available; waiting for long-run samples
literal:已载入同赛道策略基线: Strategy baseline loaded for this track
literal:正赛处于红旗暂停；恢复比赛后会沿用暂停前的代表圈继续计算。: The race is suspended under red flag. Calculation resumes from the representative laps recorded before suspension.
literal:正赛开始后会结合本场新数据持续刷新进站窗口。: The pit window updates continuously from new race data after the start.
literal:OB 只接收转播数据，不生成本机进站建议。: OB receives broadcast data only and does not generate local pit suggestions.
literal:本机车手或赛道数据已中断。: Local driver or track data was interrupted.
literal:测试期间出现黄旗或红旗，测试已终止。: A yellow or red flag occurred; the test was stopped.
literal:测试期间收到新的警告或处罚，测试已终止。: A new warning or penalty was received; the test was stopped.
literal:车手状态已中断，测试已终止。: Driver status was interrupted; the test was stopped.
literal:从维修区出口开始，完成一整圈后按正常路线进站并完成一次模拟换胎。: Start at pit exit, complete one full lap, then enter normally and complete a simulated tire service.
literal:从维修区出口驶出，出站圈即将开始。: Leave pit exit; the out lap is about to start.
literal:飞驰圈进行中：完成一个有效圈，不要暂停、回转、进站或越过赛道边界: Flying lap in progress: complete a valid lap without pausing, rewinding, pitting or leaving the route.
literal:换胎已完成，保持限速并驶出维修区出口。: Tire service complete. Stay within the limit and leave through pit exit.
literal:检测到赛道边界事件，测试已终止。: A route-boundary event was detected; the test was stopped.
literal:检测到无效单圈，测试已终止。: An invalid lap was detected; the test was stopped.
literal:检测到暂停或回转，测试已终止。: A pause or rewind was detected; the test was stopped.
literal:开始后先进入维修区并从出口驶出；系统会同时核对圈线、赛道行程、限: Enter the pit area and leave through the exit first. The test checks lap crossing, route travel, speed limit and total pit time.
literal:开始后先跑完准备圈；下一圈才是需要完成的飞驰圈。: Complete the preparation lap first; the following lap is the flying lap.
literal:开始后先完整通过一次终点线，随后连续跑完系统指定圈数。: Cross the finish line once, then complete the required consecutive laps.
literal:练习赛已经结束，测试已自动关闭。: Practice ended; the test closed automatically.
literal:没有取得完整、可信的维修区用时。: No complete, reliable pit time was recorded.
literal:没有完成一整圈的有效行程就驶离维修区，测试已终止。: The pit area was left without a complete valid lap of travel; the test was stopped.
literal:排位模拟过程中进入了维修区，测试已终止。: The pit area was entered during qualifying simulation; the test was stopped.
literal:尚未完成模拟换胎就离开维修区，测试已终止。: The pit area was left before simulated tire service finished; the test was stopped.
literal:尚未完成模拟换胎就驶离维修区，测试已终止。: The pit area was exited before simulated tire service finished; the test was stopped.
literal:停入换胎区并完成模拟换胎，期间不要超速或接受处罚。: Stop in the service zone and complete simulated tire service without speeding or receiving a penalty.
literal:完成出站圈后没有立即进站，测试已终止。: The vehicle did not pit immediately after the out lap; the test was stopped.
literal:完成当前出站圈后按正常路线进站；终点位于维修区内时，直接进入维修: Complete the current out lap, then pit normally. If the finish lies inside the pit area, enter directly and continue.
literal:完成准备圈后跑一个有效飞驰圈，熟悉排位流程并留下单圈基线。: After the preparation lap, complete one valid flying lap to establish a qualifying baseline.
literal:维修区内发生超速，测试已终止。: Pit speeding occurred; the test was stopped.
literal:先驶出维修区，完成一个准备圈。: Leave the pit area and complete one preparation lap.
literal:先驶出维修区，正常完成准备圈后开始长距离测试。: Leave the pit area and complete a normal preparation lap before the long run.
literal:先正常进入维修区，再从出口驶出。: Enter the pit area normally, then leave through the exit.
literal:现在立即进入维修区，不要再完成一圈。: Pit now; do not complete another lap.
literal:长距离测试中进入了维修区，测试已终止。: The pit area was entered during the long run; the test was stopped.
literal:只有练习赛阶段可以开始策略测试。: Strategy tests can start only during practice.
literal:终止前尚未形成可用于策略计算的完整数据。: No complete strategy sample was formed before the test ended.
literal:准备圈：正常通过终点线，下一圈开始飞驰。: Preparation lap: cross the finish line normally; the next lap is the flying lap.
literal:准备圈：正常通过终点线后开始计算长距离圈数。: Preparation lap: long-run lap counting starts after a normal finish-line crossing.
literal:车队名称不能超过 24 个字符。: The team name cannot exceed 24 characters.
literal:服务端地址无效。请输入域名或 IP，可包含端口。: Invalid server address. Enter a domain or IP address, optionally with a port.
literal:服务端返回了与请求不一致的连接身份。: The server returned a connection identity that does not match the request.
literal:服务端没有返回有效的房间信息。: The server did not return valid room information.
literal:该服务端不支持 OB 身份，请更新服务端后重试。: This server does not support the OB role. Update it and try again.
literal:连接中断，正在尝试恢复赛事连接…: Connection interrupted; restoring the race connection…
literal:连接自托管赛事服务，显示多车排名、位置、旗语和处罚。: Connects to a self-hosted race server for multi-car standings, positions, flags and penalties.
literal:练习赛已经进入下一节，当前测试已自动结束。: Practice advanced to the next session; the current test ended automatically.
literal:没有找到本机参赛车手。: The local racing driver was not found.
literal:赛事 Logo 超过客户端大小限制。: The race logo exceeds the client size limit.
literal:赛事 Logo 的 SHA-256 与服务端声明不一致。: The race logo SHA-256 does not match the server declaration.
literal:赛事 Logo 类型不受支持。: The race logo type is not supported.
literal:赛事服务返回的登录数据无效。: The race server returned invalid login data.
literal:赛事服务返回了非文本消息。: The race server returned a non-text message.
literal:赛事服务拒绝登录。: The race server rejected the login.
literal:赛事服务命令发送超时。: Sending the race-server command timed out.
literal:赛事服务尚未连接。: The race server is not connected.
literal:赛事服务未返回有效的登录确认。: The race server did not return a valid login acknowledgement.
literal:赛事服务消息超过大小限制。: The race-server message exceeds the size limit.
literal:赛事服务已关闭连接。: The race server closed the connection.
literal:赛事连接已经中断，测试已自动关闭。: The race connection was interrupted; the test closed automatically.
literal:尚未进入赛事房间。: No race room has been joined.
literal:尚未载入服务端指定的地产环道。: The estate circuit specified by the server is not loaded.
literal:已跳过一次异常赛事快照，连接仍在继续: One invalid race snapshot was skipped; the connection remains active
literal:主题色必须使用 #RRGGBB 格式。: The theme color must use #RRGGBB format.
literal:OB 不参与练习测试。: OB does not participate in practice tests.
literal:OB 不参与准备与比赛流程。: OB does not participate in readiness or racing.

literal:已进入计划进站流程；继续沿维修区路线通过终点并停入换胎区。: The planned stop has started. Follow the pit route through the finish and stop in the service zone.
literal:两份会话可直接共用同一套地产赛道坐标。: Both sessions can use the same estate-track coordinates directly.
literal:拟合结果接近可用，但误差偏大；建议增加标记点并重复进入地产验证。: The fit is close but error remains high. Add markers and repeat the estate check.

literal:至少需要两个同名标记点；三个以上非共线点才能可靠判断坐标关系。: At least two matching markers are required; three or more non-collinear points are needed for a reliable coordinate comparison.
literal:坐标存在稳定的平移、旋转或高度偏移，可通过一次标定共用赛道。: The coordinates have a stable translation, rotation or height offset and can share the track after calibration.

literal:比赛方向采样至少需要 2 米位移。: Race-direction capture requires at least two meters of travel.
